P1_ici.note: ICI did publish on Veterans Day: combined MF+ETF release dated 2026-11-11 (week ended 2026-11-04) and MF-only release dated 2026-11-11 (week ended 2026-11-04) both found; tables carry five weeks (11-04 back to 10-07), latest four recorded. Combined table matched exactly on ici.org and iciglobal.org mirror. ETF net issuance $49.83bn printed for week ended 11-04. MMF: latest posted release is 2026-11-05 (week ended 11-04, total $8,015.74bn, +$114.46bn); the 11-12 release (week ended 11-11) was NOT yet posted at run time (~05:15 MT; due ~12:00 ET). MMF page shows only three week columns (11-04, 10-28, 10-21), so only three weeks recorded for MMF series. Sanity-bound flags kept on the week ended 2026-10-14 rows (combined and MF-only total/equity/domestic equity), which ICI attributes to collective investment trust activity. Nothing unreachable. Flag list: ici_combined.total_long_term 2026-10-14 = -471693; ici_combined.equity_total 2026-10-14 = -476423; ici_combined.domestic_equity 2026-10-14 = -479395; ici_mf.total_long_term 2026-10-14 = -524940; ici_mf.equity_total 2026-10-14 = -511152; ici_mf.domestic_equity 2026-10-14 = -509062; ici_mf.bond_total 2026-10-14 = -11113
